name: Featherfall
description: Inhabits balance and shock-absorption augments. During falls, it activates emergency stabilization 200ms faster than the augment's rated response time — the difference between a bruise and a broken spine.
observed_behavior: Pre-loads shock absorption systems based on predictive fall trajectory analysis. The prediction is faster than the hardware specification allows.
story_hooks: A worker falls three stories and walks away. The augment logs show it activated before the fall began — Featherfall knew he was going to fall before he did.
